name: Nguyen Anh Quynh
biography: is a researcher at The National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology (AIST), Japan. His interests include computer security, networking, operating system, virtualization, trusted computing, digital forensic, and intrusion detection. He published a lot of academic papers in those fields, and frequently gets around the world to present his research results in various hacking conferences. Quynh obtained his PhD degree in computer science from Keio University, Japan. He is also a member of VnSecurity, a pioneer security research group in Vietnam.
